svg.title: Ila records her reason before authorising damage to the gate.
svg.desc: Ila writes the emergency purpose, her authority and the time in the red ledger while Cecil records water depth, the blocked gate and the empty pump foundation. Babul-da waits at the barrier joint.
svg.text: Page 49, panel 3 · Top-down view of Ila writing against the gate

text.tspan: Human authority becomes a time-stamped, attributable
